stops.name: Windachtal
stops.quote: Nature takes centre stage in the Ötztal Nature Park: glacier worlds in the quiet zones of the Ötztal and Stubai Alps, rustic Swiss pine forests in the Windachtal, and the towering Engelswand near Umhausen, home to rare flora and fauna.

stops.name: Lake Piburg
stops.quote: At Lake Piburg, shimmering waters contrast with dramatic rockfall scenery, while the Naturpark House in Längenfeld offers a multimedia experience of the natural world.

stops.name: Längenfeld
stops.quote: Längenfeld : Home to the Aqua Dome, a large thermal spa.

stops.name: Aqua Dome
stops.quote: For relaxation, the Aqua Dome in Längenfeld offers rejuvenation, while the Ötzi Village provides fascinating insights into prehistoric life.

stops.name: Stuiben Falls
stops.quote: Umhausen : Features the Stuiben Falls, Tirol’s highest waterfall, and the Ötzi Village.

stops.name: Wildspitze
stops.quote: The highest mountain in the Ötztal is the Wildspitze, standing at 3,768 metres above sea level.

stops.name: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
stops.quote: Obergurgl : Famous for the Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and alpine activities.
